name: Snow Report
description: A resort's morning snow report, led by new snow, with figures that count up, lifts and runs as meters, and the forecaster's note.

props.name: report
props.description: The reading: { resort, date, time, title?, status?, new24, new7, base, summit, baseAltitude?, summitAltitude?, temperature: { summit, base }, wind: { speed, direction }, lifts: { open, total }, runs: { open, total }, note?, forecaster?: { name, role?, avatar? }, next? }. Depths are in centimetres, temperatures in °C, wind speed in km/h and direction a compass point such as "NW" (where the wind comes from; the arrow points where it blows). title defaults to "Morning report", status shows as a pill in the header, next is a short line beside the forecaster such as "Next report at 12:00". New snow in 24 hours is set large beside a measuring stake; every figure counts up once when the card comes into view, and the lift and run meters fill. Under reduced motion the final values show at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Other article props are passed through.
